choose.when: SELECT t_sys_menu.id, t_sys_menu.name, t_sys_menu.path, t_sys_menu.component, t_sys_menu.redirect, t_sys_menu.wrappers, t_sys_menu.icon, t_sys_menu.create_time AS createTime, t_sys_menu.update_time AS updateTime, t_sys_menu.menu_config AS menuConfig, t_sys_menu.hide_in_menu AS hideInMenu, t_sys_menu.perm_id AS permId, t_sys_menu.menu_type AS menuType, t_sys_menu.is_frame AS isFrame, t_sys_menu.is_cache AS isCache, t_sys_menu.visible, t_sys_menu.status, t_app_res_relation.app_id AS appId, t_app_res_relation.pid AS pid, t_app_res_relation.order_num AS orderNum FROM t_app_res_relation INNER JOIN t_sys_menu ON t_app_res_relation.res_id = t_sys_menu.id AND t_app_res_relation.res_type = 'menu' AND t_app_res_relation.disabled = 0 WHERE t_app_res_relation.app_id = #{appId}
choose.otherwise: SELECT t_sys_menu.id, t_sys_menu.pid AS pid, t_sys_menu.name, t_sys_menu.path, t_sys_menu.component, t_sys_menu.redirect, t_sys_menu.wrappers, t_sys_menu.icon, t_sys_menu.create_time AS createTime, t_sys_menu.update_time AS updateTime, t_sys_menu.menu_config AS menuConfig, t_sys_menu.hide_in_menu AS hideInMenu, t_sys_menu.perm_id AS permId, t_sys_menu.order_num AS orderNum, t_sys_menu.menu_type AS menuType, t_sys_menu.is_frame AS isFrame, t_sys_menu.is_cache AS isCache, t_sys_menu.visible, t_sys_menu.status, NULL AS appId FROM t_sys_menu WHERE 1=1

arr.pid
t_sys_menu.pid

INNER JOIN t_app_res_relation arr ON t_sys_menu.id = arr.res_id AND arr.res_type = 'menu' AND arr.app_id = #{appId}

select chi.id, chi.pid AS pid, chi.name, chi.path, chi.component, chi.redirect, chi.wrappers, chi.icon, chi.create_time AS createTime, chi.update_time AS updateTime, chi.menu_config AS menuConfig, chi.hide_in_menu AS hideInMenu, chi.perm_id AS permId, chi.order_num AS orderNum, chi.menu_type AS menuType, chi.is_frame AS isFrame, chi.is_cache AS isCache, chi.visible, chi.status, fa.name as pName, t_sys_perm.name as perm from t_sys_menu chi left join t_sys_menu fa on fa.id = chi.pid left join t_sys_perm on t_sys_perm.id = chi.perm_id where chi.id = #{id}
